title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Protecting What You Build: Insurance, NIS, and Estate Basics

questions.text: Which of the following is NOT a benefit funded by NIS contributions according to the narration?
questions.explanation: The narration states that NIS contributions fund sickness benefits, maternity leave, invalidity coverage, and a monthly retirement pension; travel insurance is not listed as an NIS-funded benefit.

questions.text: True or false: Naming direct beneficiaries on financial products such as life insurance policies, credit union accounts, and pension plans allows the funds to be received directly without waiting through probate.
questions.explanation: The narration explains that naming direct beneficiaries on these financial products lets the funds be received directly, avoiding months or years of probate.
